reading.title: Bioluminescence in Deep-Sea Organisms
reading.passage: Bioluminescence, the production of light by living organisms, serves multiple functions in deep-sea ecosystems where sunlight cannot penetrate. Many fish and squid emit light for communication, predation, and camouflage. The chemical reaction involves luciferin and luciferase enzymes, producing visible light with minimal energy waste. This adaptation demonstrates how evolution enables survival in extreme environments, making bioluminescent creatures among nature's most efficient light producers.

questions.q: According to the passage, what are the primary functions of bioluminescence in deep-sea organisms?
options: Energy production and temperature regulation
Communication, predation, and camouflage
Photosynthesis and nutrient absorption
Attraction of surface-dwelling prey
questions.explanation: 패시지의 두 번째 문장에서 명시적으로 'emit light for communication, predation, and camouflage'라고 제시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred about bioluminescence as an evolutionary adaptation?
options: It evolved recently in response to climate change
It is less efficient than other light production methods
It enables organisms to survive in environments without sunlight
It is primarily used for territorial defense
questions.explanation: 패시지에서 깊은 바다에는 햇빛이 도달할 수 없으며, 생물발광이 이러한 극단적 환경에서의 생존을 가능하게 한다고 설명합니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Technology has made human relationships less meaningful. Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 배경(Technology의 현대 역할) + 명확한 입장 표시(동의/불동의) + 핵심 논거 미리보기. 예: 'While some argue that technology isolates people, I believe it has enhanced our capacity for meaningful connections through accessibility and diverse communication channels.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 논거: 기술이 지리적 제약을 극복하는 방식. 예시: 장거리 가족 간 비디오 통화, 국제 우정 형성, 온라인 커뮤니티에서의 깊은 상호작용
structure.body2: 두 번째 논거: 기술의 부정적 측면 인정하되, 개인의 선택이 중요함을 논거. 예시: 소셜미디어 중독 vs 의도적인 사용, 대면 시간과 디지털 연결의 균형
structure.conclusion: 재확인(기술 자체보다 사용 방식이 중요) + 미래 전망 + 최종 주장 재정리

key_phrases: However, it is important to note that

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to study in groups. Others prefer to study alone. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details to support your response.
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer to study...
sample_points: 단체 학습의 장점: 다양한 관점 노출, 서로 설명하며 이해도 증진, 동기부여 강화 (구체 예시: 어려운 수학 문제를 친구와 함께 풀 때 여러 해법 발견)
개인 학습의 장점: 자신의 속도 조절, 깊이 있는 집중, 방해 제거 (예시: 시험 전 조용한 도서관에서 심화 개념 학습)
결론: 과목이나 학습 목표에 따라 혼합 방식 추천 (예: 개념 이해는 개인 학습, 복습은 그룹 학습)

listening.title: Registration for Spring Semester Courses
listening.script:
Student A: Hey, did you register for your spring courses yet? I'm having trouble deciding which electives to take.

Student B: Yeah, I registered yesterday. The system was pretty crowded, but I managed to get into most of my preferred classes.

Student A: Which courses did you choose? I'm thinking about taking Environmental Science and Digital Marketing, but I'm worried they might overlap with my major requirements.

Student B: I'd recommend checking with an academic advisor before finalizing your schedule. My advisor helped me understand which electives actually count toward graduation requirements. She also warned me that some popular courses fill up quickly.

Student A: That's a good point. Do you know if the registration office has extended hours next week?

Student B: I think they're open until 7 PM on weekdays. You should definitely go in person if you have specific questions. The online FAQ section didn't answer most of my questions anyway.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
options: Differences between major and elective courses
Spring semester course registration and selection
How to avoid crowded registration times
The importance of academic advisors
questions.explanation: 두 학생이 봄 학기 과목 등록, 선택 과정, 그리고 이와 관련된 조언에 대해 논의하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What does Student B suggest Student A do?
options: Register for courses immediately online
Avoid taking electives altogether
Consult with an academic advisor before finalizing the schedule
Wait until the registration office extends its hours
questions.explanation: Student B는 'I'd recommend checking with an academic advisor before finalizing your schedule'라고 명시적으로 조언합니다.

questions.q: Why does Student B mention that popular courses fill up quickly?
options: To explain why the registration system was crowded
To suggest that Student A should register soon to avoid missing out
To explain why academic advisors are unhelpful
To discourage Student A from taking electives
questions.explanation: 이 정보는 Student A가 원하는 과목들을 빨리 등록해야 할 필요성을 암시하며, 등록 마감의 시급성을 강조합니다.
